source.scope: Observed quest pass across multiple regions
source.note: Quest data is not currently present in rogue_data.vpack. Dialogue, objectives, coordinates, and rewards were observed in game.

quests.name: Welcome to Silvest
quests.area: Silvest Town - outside the starting building
quests.initial_dialogue: Welcome to Silvest! You can press "F1" to get your bearings. Let me also give you some directions of places to go!

objectives.text: Talk to Hicklen at the southern outpost
objectives.dialogue: Hello! I assume my friend sent you, why don't you try killing some monsters for me? Press "Q" to toggle attack and click on a monster, or, press ta
Welcome back! Do you see that purple portal below me? Please go to it and left click it to set your respawn when you die!

notes: Observed behavior: walking near the spawn gate completes the objective; left clicking was not required.

objectives.dialogue: Did Hicklen treat you well? Hopefully this helped guide you somewhat in this world!

turn_in.name: Town Guide
turn_in.dialogue: Please see my friend when you want to leave Silvest!

quests.name: Leave Silvest
quests.initial_dialogue: Hey there, are you wanting to leave Silvest? My friend, Jed at the docks can guide you. The docks are to the north.

objectives.text: Speak to Priest Jed at the Docks
objectives.dialogue: Did Brother John send you? If you're looking to leave Silvest, you can have my ticket to go on the boat! *he hands you his ticket* Go see Brother

notes: Left click the boat to travel to Jeel, then speak to Brother Tom.

turn_in.name: Brother Tom
turn_in.dialogue: Hey there traveler, welcome to Jeel! This land is called Krythan, I hope you enjoy your adventures here!

quests.name: Silvest Explorer
quests.area: Silvest Town - outside the starting building
quests.initial_dialogue: Zalen of Silvest has requested you to explore silvest, along with investigate the rumors of William the Young's father.

objectives.text: Find William the Young and speak to him
Explore the cave near William's house
Look for clues of William's father's fate
objectives.dialogue: You see a memorial to William's father

objectives.text: Tell William the news of his father
objectives.dialogue: I am not surprised he died...

quests.name: Mastery of Silvest
quests.initial_dialogue: The people of Silvest need your help from monsters. Can you help me clear them out of Silvest for good?

turn_in.name: Champion of Silvest
turn_in.dialogue: You have proven yourself to be a champion of Silvest, Thank you!

quests.name: Bark At The Docks
quests.area: Silvest Town - south of the farms
quests.initial_dialogue: My dog Torgal ran off to the north towards the boats where people leave Silvest. Can you please go and look for him and let me know if you see him?

objectives.dialogue: The dog looks at you and barks, and rubs against your leg. This must be the dog Clive told you about. Return to him and let him know.

turn_in.name: Clive
turn_in.dialogue: Torgal is at the docks? I'll head there immediately. Thank you!

quests.name: A Thief's Gambit
quests.area: Silvest Town - east of the Bank
quests.initial_dialogue: My former gang is to the north in a abandoned outpost and kept some of my valuables when I left. Look for my chest in the outpost.

objectives.dialogue: The chest is empty. Something seems amiss, return to Pyke when the area is cleared.

turn_in.name: Pyke
turn_in.dialogue: What, my chest was empty? I'll have to go check into this soon. Here's your reward.

quests.name: A Snack For A Snack
quests.area: Silvest Town - southwest of the Bank
quests.initial_dialogue: Hello adventurer! I need some snake meat for a meal tonight. Could you go retrieve me some?

notes: Observed behavior: getting near the ladder completes the objective; entering the Snake Pit was not required.
The quest text displayed a quantity of 1, but 20 Raw Snake Meat were required in the observed playthrough.

quests.name: Deadly Kobold Spears
quests.initial_dialogue: Kobolds keep attacking from the south, and the locals are upset. Tomard at the outpost has asked you to look into it.

quests.name: Investigate the Undead
quests.initial_dialogue: Our outpost is constantly under attack by undead from the north. Can you see what is further to the north and report back?

stages.label: Stop the summoning
stages.unlocks_after: Find the Source of Undead; the first two kill objectives do not need to be complete

turn_in.name: Tomard
turn_in.dialogue: You found Dark Mages??? They must be summoning the undead. Thank you for dispatching them.

quests.name: Grave Consequences
quests.initial_dialogue: The Jeel cemetary has come alive and overrun! My guards cannot handle all of the undead by themselves.

quests.name: The Backroom
quests.initial_dialogue: The backroom of the potion shop has something strange about it... My friend fell through the floor ...and there is groaning noises!

notes: Enter through the trapdoor, then left-click the Scared Thief.

objectives.text: Investigate the noises echoing throughout the halls
Report your findings to the Guard Captain of Hothbra

turn_in.name: Guard Captain of Hothbra
turn_in.dialogue: You have reported your findings to the town guard in hopes they will take it seriously.

quests.name: The Highwayman's Due
quests.initial_dialogue: Bandits keep attacking Hothbra's citizens on the roads. Please help us!

turn_in.name: Town Crier
turn_in.dialogue: Thank you so much, the road is more safe now.

quests.name: Scurvy Dogs
quests.initial_dialogue: My crew is runnin' a mutiny! They took me leg and left me out to dry. I'll pay ye to clear them out!

turn_in.name: Jack Sparrow
turn_in.dialogue: Aye, ye did a good job. Here's ye reward.

quests.name: Lotor's Ettin Slayer
quests.initial_dialogue: Slay Ettins and collect their ribs on behalf of King Lotor

turn_in.name: King Lotor
turn_in.dialogue: Thank you for your efforts slaying the ettins!

quests.name: Wailing Souls
quests.area: New Korelth - North of NK Bank
quests.initial_dialogue: Ghosts have taken over the crypt of New Korleath. Are you capable of checking into them?

turn_in.name: Guard Captain
turn_in.area: New Korelth - North of NK Bank
turn_in.dialogue: Some observers told me of your encounters in there, thank you for looking into it.

quests.name: The Scared Guard
quests.initial_dialogue: Ghosts have taken over the crypt of New Korleath. Are you capable of checking into them?

turn_in.name: Scared Guard
turn_in.dialogue: I watched you from afar and saaw you handle those menaces. Thank you. Please don't tell anyone I was scared...

quests.name: The Approaching Orcs
quests.initial_dialogue: Orcs have been flooding into the outskirts of Vrethpool and endangering our people, please help!

quests.name: Where There's Smoke
quests.initial_dialogue: Hellish creaturs keep escaping from the portal to the east. Please check into it and clear it out.

turn_in.name: Mayor of Vrethpool
turn_in.dialogue: The creatures keep coming, but you have done your diligence of clearing some out.

quests.name: A Headless Problem
quests.initial_dialogue: My leg hurts... the captain tasked me with clearing the surrounding areas, but if you do it I'll give you half my wage.

turn_in.name: Lazy Guard
turn_in.dialogue: Thanks for helping me. My leg is feeling better.

quests.name: Banished No More
quests.initial_dialogue: The banished realm bleeds into ours. Spirits from another world march beneath a dead sky.

turn_in.name: Jimothy
turn_in.dialogue: The rift is sealed. The banished army crumbles.

quests.name: The Fallen Order
quests.initial_dialogue: The banished knights are the elite of their order. Each is a master of war.

turn_in.name: Jimothy
turn_in.dialogue: The last banished knight kneels. Their order ends.

quests.name: Feathers and Fury
quests.initial_dialogue: Harpies sweep from the cliffs. Minotaurs stampede through the foothills. Something drives the wild creatures mad.

turn_in.name: Preston the Archer
turn_in.dialogue: The roads are clear once more.

services.name: Create a Guild
services.result: Pay 50 gold in the prompt to create a guild for the character immediately.
notes: This interaction is recorded as a service, not a quest.
